guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Join the Wick Waitlist
guide.description: Go to the Wick waitlist and connect your EVM wallet. Approve the connection request, and the page adds your wallet to the list.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the Wick waitlist and connect your EVM wallet. Approve the connection request, and the page adds your wallet to the list.

guide.title: Share Wick on X
guide.description: Complete the X share task to post about Wick from your account. Follow Wick on X while you’re there, since the team posts its launch news there.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Complete the X share task to post about Wick from your account. Follow Wick on X while you’re there, since the team posts its launch news there.

guide.title: Join the Wick Discord
guide.description: Join the Wick Discord to follow announcements and ask questions.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Join the Wick Discord to follow announcements and ask questions.

guide.title: Claim Your Referral Link
guide.description: Open the referral section on the waitlist page, enter a name, and claim your personal referral link. This option only unlocks after your wallet is registered in Step 1.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the referral section on the waitlist page, enter a name, and claim your personal referral link. This option only unlocks after your wallet is registered in Step 1.

guide.title: Explore the Wick Docs
guide.description: Read through the Wick docs to learn how wAMM, wLIT, wLLP, and sWICK work. Knowing the products in advance helps you act quickly once deposits open on Lighter EVM.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Read through the Wick docs to learn how wAMM, wLIT, wLLP, and sWICK work. Knowing the products in advance helps you act quickly once deposits open on Lighter EVM.
